svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One voice turn, step by step
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of one Cortecho voice turn between you, the Echo Dot, Cortecho, the OpenAI API and tools. Connect: Noise handshake, subscribe to the voice assistant, time sync. Listen: the wake word starts a run, the Echo streams 16 kHz audio until Cortecho’s VAD hears 800 ms of silence. Think: transcription, agent turn, an MCP tool call, the answer streamed. Speak: text to speech from the first sentence, the reply link sent in TTS_END, the Echo downloads the WAV while it is generated and plays it. Follow-up: when the agent called listen_for_reply, the Echo listens again without the wake word.
